method:
# ThemeDefinition mapping candidate

Read-only source study. No repository files changed and no producer/build ran.

## Artifacts

- `theme-definition-candidate.json`: complete candidate category/key/property table; source roles; full default declarations with selector, enclosing conditions and file/line; existing alias dependencies; component CSS consumers; unresolved rows; private channels/registrations; source hashes.
- `summary.json`: counts, channel gates, unresolved rows and typography gaps.
- `raw-inventory.json`: complete parsed root declarations and all 8,164 declarations in the 220 actually imported component/shared stylesheets, including keyframes.
- `all-token-values.txt`: every root variable and every distinct authored default value, without selecting one assumed appearance result.
- `font-weight-provenance.json`: exact upstream CSS, extracted spec nodes and mapping paths for the three font-family-variable uses in font-weight.
- `inspect.ts`, `classify.ts`, `finalize.ts`, `trace-font-weights.ts`: reproduction scripts. Run with Bun from this directory; they only write scratch JSON/text here.

## Coverage

The two complete CSS token sources contain 5,257 root declarations defining 429 distinct custom properties. Seventy independent numeric spacing/size records come from the shared catalog. The candidate maps 407 rows, excludes 84 raw color-channel fields, and leaves eight explicitly unclassified rows. It also records 113 private composition registrations and all consumer-only variables that lack a root token definition.

All 2,343 consumer variable occurrences were cross-checked against Lightning CSS's AST Variable visitor counts, per file. Keyframes are included. Root custom-property declaration counts were checked against parsed AST declaration blocks, including important declarations. Input hashes were unchanged at finalization. This is complete static coverage, not proof that every selector matches at runtime.

## Key convention and categories

Use each existing CSS basename as its nonnumeric dictionary key: `colors["ds-blue-700"]` maps only to `--ds-blue-700`; `fonts["acme-font-sans"]` maps only to `--acme-font-sans`. Numeric spacing/sizes retain the approved decimal keys and canonical variable names. Generate literal TypeScript key unions from the mapping; do not introduce camelCase/unprefixed aliases.

Counts: colors 215; fonts 8; fontSizes 13; fontWeights 0; lineHeights 4; spacing 64 (35 numeric, 29 named roles); sizes 58 (35 numeric, 23 named roles); radii 6; shadows 31; motion 8. Named size/spacing roles remain separate from numeric property-token acceptance; this proposal does not make role names into new numeric layout aliases. Existing role dependencies and their original units remain recorded.

## Gates, not hidden public fields

HSL `-value` triplets and RGB channel lists are not CSS colors. Select directly consumes red900 channels for a 16% ring; Toggle directly consumes gray1000 channels for 84% thumb backgrounds twice. Avatar Group and Tooltip each redeclare 82 palette colors locally from channels. Those patterns must be handled by the generator/theme integration before arbitrary public color overrides can be certified. Grid System's three debug-color-rgb uses are private diagnostics, not palette-token overrides.

There are no root font-weight tokens. Of 143 current component font-weight declarations, 140 are literals and 3 use font-family variables. Those 3 originate in the captured upstream stylesheet, not in a house property-name substitution: the source classes are `font-[var(--font-sans)]` and `font-[var(--font-sans-fallback)]`. The corresponding source CSS already assigns font-weight. House simplification drops the private --tw-font-weight assignment and preserves font-weight. Exact source evidence is in the provenance JSON. Do not infer an intended weight or silently recategorize font-family keys as weights.

Current font-size and line-height tokens also cover only part of the typography. The candidate saves the complete literal declarations needed to plan that wiring.

Unclassified root fields: acme-text-gradient (gradient image), ds-focus-ring-outline (outline shorthand), ds-overlay-backdrop-opacity (opacity), and the five ds-z-* layer-order tokens. They remain explicit local CSS roles; do not force them into colors or shadows to make the table appear complete.

The default rows preserve all source contexts and ordering, including light/dark, capability/gamut conditions and root layout selectors. Do not flatten them into one guessed default or assume a derived custom-property alias recomputes in a nested scope merely because a dependent variable changes.
